title: fix(service-knowledge): a source naming an unmounted adapter is logged once at boot
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Fixes #37479

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 运维人员看启动日志时,一个指向未挂载存储的知识源从两行告警变为一行错误,错误里写明知识源、存储名和可选的已挂载存储;用户无感。
- 属于知识检索平台(AI 检索)史诗,替看启动日志的运维人员去掉重复噪音。
- 出错只会让这条错误多一行或少一行,检索与建索引的行为不变,可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- `packages/services/service-knowledge/src/knowledge-service.ts` `buildIfDue`: at boot, a source whose adapter is not mounted is skipped by the first-build pass without a line. Before, the pass read its index state, `getAdapter` threw the unmounted-adapter refusal, and the pass logged it at `warn` as "is not built at boot: what the adapter holds could not be read (...)", beside the `error` that `reportUnmountedAdapters` already prints at `kernel:bootstrapped`. Now the boot says it once, at `error`, naming the source, the adapter and the mounted adapters.
- On reload (a `knowledge_source` item added while the process runs) nothing changes: no boot reading runs then, so the reload build's `warn` is still the one line that names the source.
- Indexing and searching such a source still answer the coded `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` 503 (PR #37442); not touched.

This is item 1 of the re-scope (card comment 7187970703). Item 2, a publish or `os validate` refusal of an adapter name no deployment can serve, is NOT in this PR: it would narrow what is accepted, and the area decides. Options are in the dev report on the card. That is why this PR says `Part of` and leaves the card open.

## Tests

- New pin in `src/__tests__/knowledge-build.test.ts`: with a data engine bound, one mounted source and one naming `pgvector` (not mounted), the boot pass plus the boot reading produce exactly one log line naming `'docs'` across debug/info/warn/error. That line is at `error` and names the adapter as not mounted. The mounted source is still built (`status: 'done'`).
- Ablation: with the new guard line replaced by a comment, the pin goes red: `expected [ [ 'warn', …(1) ], [ 'error', …(1) ] ] to have a length of 1 but got 2` (1 failed, 22 passed). With the line restored, the file is green (23 passed).

<details><summary>Package test and typecheck (head 13f32fc828)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge typecheck` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 17 passed (17), Tests 529 passed (529). `typecheck` is `tsc --noEmit && pnpm check:test-typecheck`, so the test files are type-checked too.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Item 2 of re-scope 7187970703 (a publish or `os validate` refusal) is closed by area decision D, with no publish-time refusal added. The refusal point is boot: `reportUnmountedAdapters` prints a coded error naming the source and the adapter. `searchWithRefusals` lists such a source as refused (`knowledge-service.ts` near :1882), and index and search answer the coded 503 (PR #37442 and this PR). Options A (save-time admission) and B (a `ragflow` tombstone) stay in the dev report on the card, for a future card.
- The claim's file surface pointed at `:372` as "the boot build pass's kept(...) line". On origin/main 73d5e347f7, `:372` is `dropMetadataSource`'s `kept(...)`, which runs when a source is removed, not at boot. The second boot line comes from `buildIfDue` (the `warn` of an `unreadable` index reading). The fix sits there, and `dropMetadataSource` is not touched.
- Public surface: no exported type, export or wire shape changes. No dependent package owes a test.

## Verification

Read first: `knowledge-service.ts` `buildIfDue` (the one added guard line), then the new pin.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-knowledge exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/knowledge-build.test.ts` should show 23 passed. Delete the guard line `if (trigger === 'boot' && !this.adapters.has(entry.handed.adapter)) return;` and the pin fails with 2 lines (warn, error) where it expects 1.

<details><summary>Derived gates (local, head 13f32fc828): 68 exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 70 families from the 3 changed paths. All 70 ran; `--ran` with recorded exit codes: "70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 68 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".

- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, it needs every package's `dist/` (a whole-tree build). CI runs it.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:type-check-debt`, reason: its re-measure build did not get a turn on the shared verify lock (queue-timeout 99). CI runs it.

The package-wide scans (`pnpm lint` and the rest of the farm) are CI's.

</details>
